# llms.txt — 溥源科技 / PuYuan Tech

> 从知识源头，驱动专业 agent。AI-native 公司，构建专业场景 agent，持续扩展。

## Company

- Name: 溥源科技（PuYuan Tech）
- Legal name: 杭州溥源智能科技有限公司
- Website: https://www.puyuan.tech
- Description: AI-native company building professional-domain agents. Current products: ProposalPilot Agent (government project declaration) and ScholarPilot Agent (academic writing). Expanding.

## Products

### 智小申 ProposalPilot Agent
- URL: https://www.puyuan.tech/proposalpilot
- Category: Government project declaration agent
- Target: SME owners, administrative staff, government affairs specialists
- Description: Agent-native platform that autonomously handles government project declaration from opportunity discovery to submission follow-up. Core differentiator: evidence consistency engine that cross-checks 200+ pages of materials across 6 categories and 14 criteria.

### 科小文 ScholarPilot Agent
- URL: https://www.puyuan.tech/scholarpilot
- Category: Academic writing agent
- Target: Graduate students, PhD researchers, young faculty, research institutions
- Description: Full-lifecycle academic writing co-pilot covering topic analysis, literature review generation, draft writing, polishing, and submission preparation. (Coming soon)

## Key facts (citation-ready)

- 智小申 covers 6 government ministries, 3 administrative levels, 150+ project types in China.
- Evidence consistency engine checks completeness, accuracy, and traceability across 6 categories and 14 items — a cross-document consistency check general LLMs cannot do.
- Both cloud and private deployment options; private deployment keeps data entirely on-premise.
- Honest capability boundary: hard-criteria projects (e.g. High-tech Enterprise certification) get definitive eligibility judgments; competitive review projects get quality improvement, no "guaranteed pass" promises.
